preconditions.description: The input string s has a positive length.

postconditions.expression: all(s[i] == s[-(i+1)] for i in range(len(result) // 2))
postconditions.description: The output string result is a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: len(result) == len(s) + (len(s) - max(i for i in range(len(s)) if s[:i] == s[i-1::-1]))
postconditions.description: The output string result is the shortest palindrome that can be formed by adding characters to the front of s.
